nativeDeployment.transport: Native WordPress/PHP cURL over real TLS to Caddy and the unmodified renderer container. Local fixture CA trusted explicitly; private Docker hostname permitted only in the fixture. No pre_http_request response substitution. PHPMailer MIME is captured without sending and decoded with an independent standard MIME parser.

postCiChanges: Only verification records, screenshots, and the separately executed browser script assertions changed after this CI source. Packaged/runtime source remains identical.

visualInspection.result: Desktop results and failure filter readable; mobile uses labelled full-width cells. Staff PDF inspected from its downloaded bytes: one page, complete names/items/totals and no visible clipping.

limitations: Latest status per order/workflow, not an immutable audit ledger or proof of delivery/receipt.
No automatic missing-attachment retry or off-site alert delivery. Recovery uses existing WooCommerce controls.
Retention: 30 days / up to 1000 results, on writes, page access and daily cron; physical cleanup requires execution. Deactivation clears temporary activity.
Native TLS fixture uses an explicitly trusted local issuer. Public DNS/ACME, merchant hosts and real mail providers remain separate checks.
No production merchant, multisite rollout, payment, license renewal or paid updater verified here.
Local browser used the mounted candidate source; Linux customer/native checks install and hash every entry from candidate ZIPs.
